summary: A speaker says a tax rise will not stay with owners but will reach renters through higher rent.
realLife: At budget hearings in two cities, residents warned that a property tax increase would move into rents and would fall hardest on the lowest-income households; one small landlord at the other end said rent rises would be smaller than the full tax rise.
sources: WBFO (Buffalo, New York), 'Buffalo residents sound off on tax hike at Buffalo Common Council budget hearing', Apr 29, 2026: https://www.btpm.org/local/2026-04-29/buffalo-residents-sound-off-on-tax-hike-at-buffalo-common-council-budget-hearing
